title: iPhone Backup Extractor overview
summary: Official documentation for the commercial tool identified in the 4chan screenshots and contemporaneous reporting.
notes: The product supports inspection and extraction from local iPhone backups and other Apple data sources.

Current documentation says direct iCloud-backup retrieval became unavailable as of May 2020, creating a question about whether the 2022 material was a local export, converted backup, live iCloud data, or another container.
Integrity status: official live documentation reviewed without a local byte capture.

data.verification_scope: Documented tool capabilities and current compatibility statements.
